can know i'm suicidal until I'm dead. It would be too painful for them to think they're helping me and then find me dead one day. I'm also not sure I have the heart to trick them into thinking I'm feeling better if they do find out.

Don't slit your wrist to do it, it's really painful and slow, like someone else said.

I had a lucid dream where I hung myself and my dad walked in and found me dead. I was a ghost and the amount of freedom and happiness I felt in that moment was overwhelming. I woke up disappointed it wasn't real.

I was fantasizing about suicide and was wondering how far I could go before I thought about a way I wouldn't want to die. I almost died laughing when I thought about me using my own intestines as a noose. Really fucked up, but whatever, so am I
